words.example: The director made a courtesy visit to the new manager of that ward.
words.exampleZh: 主任去了那个病区，对新负责人做了礼节拜访。

words.example: The auditors set their site visit for next Wednesday morning.
words.exampleZh: 审计人员把现场走访定在下周三上午。

words.example: A walk-in from the health bureau is sitting in reception right now.
words.exampleZh: 卫生局有一位未预约的来访者，这会儿正坐在接待处。

words.example: The supplier made a drop-in while the director was still in session.
words.exampleZh: 供应商顺便来访的时候，主任还在开会。

words.example: The director sees people by appointment.
A repair install fixed the viewer after the last patch removed a needed file.
words.exampleZh: 上次补丁删掉一个必要文件之后，修复安装把阅片程序修好了。

words.example: The msi package for the viewer must be the one signed by the vendor this month.
words.exampleZh: 阅片程序的安装包必须是厂商这个月签名的那一版。

words.example: The exe installer asked for an admin password on every clinic PC.
words.exampleZh: 那个可执行安装程序在每台门诊电脑上都要管理员密码。

words.example: The patch file from the vendor failed its signature check, so we did not apply it.
words.exampleZh: 厂商来的补丁文件没通过签名校验，所以我们没有装。

words.example: The hotfix rollup includes the six printer fixes we have been waiting on.
words.exampleZh: 这个累积热修复里有我们一直在等的六个打印修复。
